title: Canopy: know exactly when and where to water
talking_points: Canopy is a fictional precision irrigation platform built for this demo.
It tells a farm operations team exactly when and where to water, field by field.
This whole deck describes a fictional product. No company, price, or result here is real.

content.headline: Water the right spot, at the right time, every time

narrator_guidance: Open warmly. Say what Canopy does in one sentence, then invite a question.
